text: This is an ideal location across from Waikiki Beach, the tourist destination; however, is infested with homeless protected by the local police. Our drinks were stolen from our table as my children sat and waited for my wife and I to retrieve our order. We called a manager to pull video surveillance, which showed exactly which homeless person stole our drinks and called the police to file a theft report. The local police were completely useless, did not press any charges despite video footage, sided with the homeless thief and said if they arrested him that a thousand more would do the same thing. Really!? I received zero apologies or compensation from McDonald’s, the police I called, or the thief in the photo. In fact, the police apologized to the homeless thief for bothering him prior to leaving. The homeless thief remained in the restaurant. We will never eat here again despite the fact that we live 3 blocks away. Completely sad what some businesses do to loyal customers.
author: J I.

text:
Honestly, I’m not the type to leave reviews, but this experience left me really frustrated.

I was charged $0.99 for a coffee at the McDonald’s on Kalakaua Ave in Honolulu — and never got the drink. I tried contacting customer service twice and was told someone from the store would follow up. No one ever did. I even spent a good amount of time trying to fix this while I was on vacation, which just added to the frustration.

It’s not about the 99 cents — it’s about the complete lack of follow-through. After all this, I was basically told to go back to the same location that ignored me in the first place. I’ve wasted hours over something that should’ve been resolved with a quick refund and an apology.
Case #: 33112199

Really disappointed in how this was handled. Not sure I’ll be going back to McDonald’s anytime soon.
author: Luboslav Bujnak

text: Was curious to see if they had anything special on their menu. Not only was their service poor and delayed, but I literally saw the cashier employee try to give me the burger that they had mistakenly put on someone else's plate. They still tried to serve me the same burger after someone else had touched it. That returned food is supposed to be put in the waste bin and a new burger made for the delayed customer. This all caused additional delay since I started reprimanding the girl behind the counter and asking her to have a new burger made for me. I let her know that I used to work at McDonald's and knew exactly what the protocol should be for food handling.
author: Xavier Fabian C.

text:
Came in to pick up my mobile order. Waited for over 30 minutes, no exaggeration. Eventually managed to get a hold of one of the employees to ask where my food was.

Employee turns around and grabs a bag from the kitchen area - apparently my order had been ready for a while, but none of the workers had actually brought it to the front. Obviously everything was cold and the fries were soggy. No offer to get a new batch of fries or even an apology.

To add the cherry on top, they had made the order incorrectly (ordered no mayo, had mayo on everything). Ridiculous experience. Shame!
author: Nick Sarji

text: I paid for an order and when the mobile app glitched the manager told me I didn't pay, despite me showing her the order paid in full, and me even showing my bank charge. I sat for 40 minutes, lost out on the deal, and then was told to cancel my order and reorder at the register and never use the app again. It frustrating that I was told I was wrong when I clearly had multiple statements showing I'd paid on the app, I just didn't have an order number. The other staff was happy, and it was the extremely rude manager in a red polo that told me I was lying and was beyond helpful.
author: Christopher Schrat

text: The day manager was aweful. We were staying at the Alohilani Resort and decided we just want a simple lunch.  We ordered a Mc nugget meal, 2 fish sandwiches and two pies.  The pies were reason we went there.  I got back to the hotel realized they weren't there. Went back she assured me she put 1 pie in the bag. I go back to the hotel find the reciept and my husband ordered two pies.  Instead of apologizing for error she said next time bring back the whole bag of food.  Obviously she knows nothing about the Aloha spirit which is prevalent all around the rest of the island.

text:

You are positioned in the busiest place in town and yet the line doesn't move. I understand you have special needs working but that means their should be a 2nd person helping speed up the line up.  Went 2 different days and whether it's late night or morning, same situation.
Also.. You want to charge $0.50 for tap water. Never heard of a McD's charging for a cup of tap water before.

text: I order from the app to pick up here on s regular basis. Since I am not physically in the restaurant when I order, it would be nice to be be able to see the status of my order. There is a monitor facing the lobby that is supposed to show this, however, at this restaurant it has not worked for months. Today I asked when it will be fixed and someone who works here told me that it never will be fixed!!! Why not? Every McDonald's that I have been in has a monitor that works except for this one. Quit being cheap and fix it.
